/bin/sh -lc 'git diff --stat; GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test -mod=readonly ./detector -run TestKEVMapping -count=1'
/bin/sh -lc 'gofmt -w models/kev_test.go detector/kevuln_test.go; GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test -mod=readonly ./models ./detector -count=1'

limitations: Shell/script/code-mode edits and tests may not be recognized. A failed invocation can be an environment error. Red/green does not prove the right assertion or test-first. Absence of recognized evidence is not noncompliance. Inspect full events and checkpoint.
